# Tathastu Keepsakes — order any product

> 3D-printed gifts made to order in Agra and shipped across India. Every product below is in stock and can be ordered from its own page.

Workshop: Agra, India. Material: PLA / PLA+. Payment: Razorpay on the product page. Dispatch: usually 2–4 days. Shipping: free when the order is above ₹1500; otherwise ₹99.

Order from the product link. The price shown is the selling price in INR.
